d: Chayan Rastogi and Prashant Kapoor will discuss in this video... India's bizarre situation in the first Test against New Zealand! Despite taking 5 wickets, Team India finds itself on the back foot, raising serious questions about the team's performance, strategy and, most importantly, the bizarre Playing XI.
